oneLiner: An app that plans a week of meals around what's already in the fridge.
problem: People waste food and money by not knowing what to cook with ingredients they already have, leading to last-minute takeout orders and expired groceries.
targetUser: Busy home cooks aged 25-45 who want to reduce food waste, save money, and simplify meal planning.
coreFlow: User inventories current fridge items (manually or via photo upload)
User specifies dietary preferences, servings, and cuisine preferences
App generates a customized 7-day meal plan using available ingredients
User reviews plan, adjusts meals, and gets a shopping list for missing items
User accesses recipes and cooking instructions throughout the week

screens.name: Ingredient Inventory
screens.purpose: Allow users to input, photograph, or import their current fridge contents with quantities and expiration dates

screens.name: Preferences Setup
screens.purpose: Capture dietary restrictions, cuisine preferences, servings, and cooking skill level

screens.name: Weekly Meal Plan
screens.purpose: Display the AI-generated 7-day meal plan with visual cards, ingredient usage, and ability to swap meals

screens.name: Recipe Detail
screens.purpose: Show step-by-step cooking instructions, ingredient breakdown, and nutritional information

screens.name: Shopping List
screens.purpose: Display items needed to complete the meal plan, organized by store section with quantities

outOfScope: Grocery delivery integration or shopping cart checkout
Real-time inventory tracking via smart fridge devices
Social sharing or meal plan marketplace
